gloss: to record; to document; to register

definitions.gloss: to record; to document; to write down
definitions.explanation: To preserve information by writing it down, filming it, or storing it in some form for future reference.

definitions.gloss: to set a record; to register a figure
definitions.explanation: To achieve or register a particular number, score, or measurement, especially a notable one.

examples.english: This summer registered the hottest temperatures on record, and heatstroke patients increased across the country.

notes:
A versatile suru-verb with two distinct uses. Sense 1 (to document) covers any act of preserving information — writing notes, filming, logging data, etc. Sense 2 (to register a figure) is commonly seen in news about weather records, economic figures, and sports achievements.

The noun form ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ means "record" or "documentation" and appears in many compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave on record
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to break/update a record
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保持|ほじ}→保持：05618_hoji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hold a record
- ⟦{映像|えいぞう}→映像：04444_eizou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{記録|きろく}する: to record on video
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: world record
- ⟦{記録|きろく}{的|てき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な: record-breaking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{録音|ろくおん}する→録音する：25388_rokuonsuru⟧: to record (audio) — specifically for sound recording
- ⟦{録画|ろくが}→録画：04441_rokuga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to record (video) — specifically for video recording
- ⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to describe; to state in writing — formal, used for official documents
